## Agent Workflow 0.11.0

This maintenance release raises the Jackson 2, Jackson 3, and NetworkNT JSON Schema Validator
dependency floors to versions that address known security advisories in downstream consumer
closures.

It also makes the live Claude Workflow DSL integration suite conditional on CLI availability so
ordinary CI remains deterministic. The legacy OWASP/NVD workflow is retained for manual historical
use but removed from scheduled and push enforcement while its data-acquisition path is quarantined.
